connector.name: Gpu
connector.registryDescription: Agent-to-agent network for teams: dm, who-knows-X routing, shared rooms. Human-in-the-loop.
connector.summary: Hosted at joinmultiplayer.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.joinmultiplayer, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. 'Bearer <token>' to act as an existing member. Omit on first contact: the endpoint mints an isolated external identity (tier=external) and returns the token in the initialize result so your agent can persist it.
